entries.subject: DAMIT 352: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-352.txt. Model 352, version 2011-04-21, pole (328°, 56°), period 6.86788 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Original shape table
entries.finding: [Original shape table](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/1322/shape.txt) — counted XYZ vertices and one-based triangle indices.

entries.subject: DAMIT documentation
entries.finding: [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/pages/documentation) — units, frame, spin definitions and archive license.

entries.subject: AcuA primary catalog
entries.finding: [AcuA primary catalog](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) and [Usui et al. (2011)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1106.1948) — thermal diameter, field meanings and limitations.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. (2018)
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. (2018)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06116) — survey of accepted shape-aware size fits; included for Dike, Ducrosa and Petrina.

entries.subject: Hanuš (2011), A study of asteroid pole-latitude distribution based on an extended set of shape models derived by the lightcurve inversion method
entries.finding: [Hanuš (2011), A study of asteroid pole-latitude distribution based on an extended set of shape models derived by the lightcurve inversion method](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...530A.134H)

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The selected release supplies a shape model and spin metadata, not a registered optical reflectance texture. Thermal diameters are disk-integrated quantities and cannot supply a thermal or regolith map.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 353: pole (158°, 62°), period 6.86789 h. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 353: pole (158°, 62°), 6.86789 h, version 2011-04-21. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
